articles.title: Banks seek RBI relief, clarity on India's latest rupee-defence measures: Report
articles.summary: Banks have approached the Reserve Bank of India to request changes to the 20% cash deposit mandate. They propose that a flat charge replaces the deposit requirement for current-account hedging. This change could improve liquidity while ensuring cost transparency for businesses. Lenders also highlighted concerns over the $2 million threshold, which complicates hedge tracking. Clarity is needed regarding the deposit requirement for hedges related to interest payments on foreign loans.

articles.title: Statistics ministry proposes common framework to calculate state GDP
articles.summary: The statistics ministry has proposed a common framework for estimating state gross domestic product. This framework uses an expenditure approach under the revised 2022-23 base year. Currently, no state compiles estimates of private final consumption expenditure, creating a gap. Proposed methods include using administrative data to allocate estimates across states and union territories. This initiative aims to improve consistency and comparability of GSDP estimates throughout India.

articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has announced new measures aimed at stabilizing the rupee's value in foreign exchange markets. These measures include tightening foreign exchange derivative norms and creating a special window for oil marketing companies. By implementing a cash reserve requirement for large forex derivatives, the central bank seeks to curb speculative dollar demand. The impact of these interventions is expected to affect the rupee's value and forward premiums.
